generation_source_reconciliation.limitation: Finite exact src_ts comparisons disagree. Revision/timing histories do not establish the cause. The tee records the then-current upstream view; the historical mirror is a later snapshot. The tee is excluded from production modeling; later mirror values remain observational, without independent production calibration.

mirror_consumption_semantics_check.use: Reported con_w is not used as gross load; inferred load uses EAGLE + solar.

alignment.solar: Exact timestamp only; no interpolation or forward fill

disposition.action: Continue monitoring; no sampled Range A excursion supports a utility voltage complaint in this window. Formal within-specification closure remains unsupported.
disposition.confidence: moderate for rounded monitored samples; low for service-point compliance and causal loss
disposition.reason: Gateway sensing point and accuracy are not established. Collector filters extremes, spot samples miss events and missing time. Within-range readings cannot rule out unobserved curtailment.

duration_method: Sample-and-hold represented time capped at scheduled cadence (300s voltage), stops before gaps; estimates only, not measured sustained event durations. Missing time is separate from in-range time.

frequency.interpretation: Measurement-chain sanity only; rounded 0.01 Hz, uncalibrated, and poller filters 55 < Hz < 65. No grid-frequency compliance claim.

measurement_chain.accuracy: No calibration record, calibrated comparison, or manufacturer accuracy bound established for selected channel.
measurement_chain.ambiguous_mirror_deployment_date: 2026-07-25; all voltage channels excluded for this date because old humidity/pressure coexist with new voltage meanings. Solar/grid fields retained.
measurement_chain.censoring_warning: Poller drops values outside acceptance masks. Missing values/time include filtered and failed acquisitions; extreme events cannot be ruled out.

clocks_and_units.grid: W, signed net import positive/export negative; EAGLE collector minute clock, device freshness unknown
clocks_and_units.load: Inferred gross W = simultaneous signed grid W + solar W, no installed battery; measurement/timing error remains
clocks_and_units.production: Hourly mean of >=11 common five-minute sampled powers, not integrated energy
clocks_and_units.solar: W, main mirror physical source slot; exact join to voltage slot, actual read instants not established
clocks_and_units.voltage: V, poller local clock floored to 5min; same chain in mirror
clocks_and_units.weather: Modeled POA/GHI W/m2 average over preceding hour; UTC end-of-hour label. Air temperature C is instantaneous at label.

measurement_chain.sensor: Enphase IQ Gateway selected first meter with numeric voltage; first two channels for legs

missing_evidence: Calibrated voltage comparison at the utility service point and established physical sensing point/accuracy.
Inverter trip/curtailment event records and sufficiently fast synchronized voltage and production.
On-site irradiance/module-temperature evidence or a verified unconstrained production reference.
Simultaneous upstream/service and inverter-side voltage to separate utility variation from conductor drop/export rise.
pricing: No identified loss or aligned counterfactual exists; no kWh or dollar estimate. Any future counterfactual needs canonical tariff re-billing of aligned interval flows.

conditioned_model.ci_method: OLS CR1 sandwich clustered by local date; Student t, dates minus one degrees of freedom

expected_power_reference.method: Leave-one-local-date-out OLS: modeled POA, POA squared, air temperature, POA-temperature interaction, three local-clock harmonics, quadratic season trend; no voltage or load in reference
expected_power_reference.warning: Empirical expected power is not verified uncurtailed output. Hourly sampled means are not energy meters. Do not integrate residuals as losses.

production.finding: The conditional model does not establish an inverse voltage-production association at the stated uncertainty level. This does not prove zero production loss.
production.identifiability: Voltage responds to generation as well as potentially affecting it. Weather resolution, changing shade/soiling, inferred-load coupling, omitted upstream conditions, and shared persistent losses limit interpretation. A coefficient or its interval does not establish a loss mechanism.
production.interpretation: Conditional association only. No calibrated service-point voltage, inverter event trace, or verified unconstrained production reference. Missing or sub-five-minute curtailment remains possible.
production.model_controls: Mean leg V, inferred gross load kW, modeled POA, POA squared, instantaneous hourly air temperature, POA-temperature interaction, local-hour harmonics 1-3, quadratic elapsed-day trend.

service_voltage_reference.scope: ANSI C84.1 service voltage Range A; utilization limits differ. Sustained levels, not momentary transients. Gateway sensing point is unverified.
service_voltage_reference.source_location: PG&E Voltage Tolerance Boundary, July 2018, pages 1-2, table 1

source_overlap.matched_rows_definition: Matching timestamps with any available channel per source; field comparisons use finite pairs only.

source_selection_method: Retain every available channel. Prefer local values independently per field; fill only missing local values from the same-slot mirror. Row and channel source tags distinguish mixed rows. Complete field masks gate models and complete-slot coverage, not per-field distributions or excursion evidence.

voltage_conditioned_associations.interpretation: Associations condition on same-day effects and local-clock harmonics. Solar and inferred gross load share generation data. Nighttime check reduces that coupling. Slopes cannot separate upstream impedance from premise conductor drop/rise without a calibrated service-point comparison.
